purpose: Reviewed geographic scope for globe country colors. Full coverage requires official nationwide scope evidence and a separately verified parcel source; regional samples alone remain partial.

reviews.note: Sarajevo check: FGU advertises parcel WFS services but requires sign-in; the separate public canton viewer is unreachable. No retained Sarajevo import was found in the three databases checked. Access remains inconclusive.

evidence.title: FGU: cadastral services and covered Sarajevo municipalities

reviews.note: The verified national Catastro source excludes the Basque Country and Navarre. Their separate cadastres have not been verified here, so full country coverage is not confirmed.

evidence.title: Datos.gob.es: cadastral parcels and geographic exclusions

reviews.note: Registered parcel geometry is verified in Tbilisi through the public MSDA map. Point and cadastral-code lookup work; complete area queries for app integration and nationwide completeness remain unverified.

evidence.title: MSDA public map: registered land plots

reviews.note: DGU explicitly publishes the cadastral plan for the Republic of Croatia. Its public national download index is reachable, and parcel geometry is already verified. Individual municipality downloads were not all rechecked.

evidence.title: DGU: national scope and unrestricted DKP download access

reviews.note: Public Old Bazaar parcel polygons are verified in a bounded Skopje sample. Duplicate and overlapping source shapes keep that city layer outside the runtime catalog; countrywide coverage is unconfirmed. Earlier AREC national cadastre/NSDI checks remain inconclusive.

evidence.title: City of Skopje: Old Bazaar parcel polygons

reviews.note: PDOK offers the cadastral parcel dataset for the whole Netherlands (NL). Caribbean Netherlands (BQ) is assessed separately. App city entries cover smaller areas.

LINZ defines a nationwide primary land-parcel fabric. This covers base land parcels, including roads and waterways; non-primary interests and historical/pending parcels are separate datasets. App integration is separate from this scope finding.

ANCPI documents a parcel vector service, but the Geoportal hostname does not resolve from either network checked. ANCPI reports a staged restart. Access remains inconclusive; this is not a no-data finding.

evidence.title: EU data catalogue: ANCPI parcel download service

reviews.note: Belgrade parcel geometry is confirmed by an existing import from the public RGZ WFS and its archived response. A current service check timed out; nationwide completeness is unconfirmed.

evidence.title: RGZ: public cadastral portal used by the existing importer

reviews.note: SLA describes this dataset as the entire cadastral map of Singapore's surveyed land lots. Airspace and strata products are separate. The weekly GeoJSON snapshot still needs indexing for app use.

evidence.title: SLA: entire Singapore cadastral land-lot dataset

reviews.note: GURS publishes official parcel geometries and identifiers for Slovenia through public WFS services. The official catalog identifies national coverage and unrestricted access.

evidence.title: OPSI / GURS: national real estate cadastre
